title: A computerless worker does not ack a computer continuation job
description:
As a household member, I want a cpu-only worker to refuse a computer-required continuation, so that the pending tool is not deleted from the queue before a computer-capable worker exists.

Feature: Computerless turn

Scenario: A computerless worker does not take a computer continuation job
  Given an empty control plane
  And tenant anthus user ryan has a channel with a named bot Assistant
  And tenant anthus user ryan household computer is stopped
  When user ryan posts a browser request addressed to Assistant
  And a counting computerless worker processes bot Assistant
  And tenant anthus user ryan household computer is running
  And user ryan of tenant anthus resumes that waiting turn
  And a computerless worker is given the continuation job
  Then the computerless worker refuses the computer job
  And the continuation job remains queued
  And only one worker begins the model attempt
  And the turn remains active

Not included: Fargate, executing the browser tool, staging or production.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Kernel and Gherkin: computerless run_job raises ComputerlessCannotExecuteComputerJob before waiting skip, so a computer continuation stays queued. ThinTurn-only development deploy from develop @ d99b028. Named exercise_thin_turn.py --environment development exits 0 (claim 404, second claim 409, waiting, resume-while-stopped 409). Did not live-resume while the computer is running: that would enqueue a computer job the cpu worker must nack until a computer-capable worker exists. Not staging, not production, not --all.
